title: Twelve MCP tools exposed, exceeding the spec's required query categories
evidence: src/index.ts:53-262 registers find_matches, last_match_between, team_stats, head_to_head, competitions_for_team, player_search, top_brazilian_players, brazilian_players_by_club, standings, biggest_wins, average_goals, best_record_at_venue
suggestion: None — beyond-spec coverage, noted for cross-run comparison.

title: BR-Football dataset overlaps other competitions and can double-count in aggregate stats
evidence: src/loaders.ts:875-907 maps BR-Football rows with competition=r.tournament; averageGoals/biggestWins (src/engine.ts:665,685) aggregate across ALL match sources, so matches also present in Brasileirão/Libertadores files may be counted twice
suggestion: Optionally dedupe by (date, homeTeam, awayTeam) before global aggregates, or scope aggregates by source; spec does not require dedup so this is a data-quality nuance.

title: Server smoke test boots the real stdio MCP server end-to-end
evidence: tests/server.test.ts:75-96 spawns dist/index.js, performs the MCP init handshake, lists tools (asserts >=11), and invokes last_match_between
suggestion: None — strong integration coverage; note it requires a prior build (dist/index.js).
